ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of statistics on population, cultivated land, and grassland resources in different systems of a certain temperate region of our country. The legend shows that the blank bars indicate population, the dotted bars indicate per capita cultivated land, and the diagonal-line bars indicate per capita grassland. The horizontal axis includes three systems: desert steppe, meadow steppe, and farming-pastoral combination. In the desert steppe and meadow steppe, the diagonal-line bars are clearly the highest, indicating that per capita grassland resources are abundant; the dotted bars are relatively low, indicating that per capita cultivated land resources do not have an advantage. The farming-pastoral combination system has relatively more per capita cultivated land, but less per capita grassland, and also a larger population. Then reason: The question asks about the practice that “does not conform to the direction of sustainable development in this region.” This temperate region as a whole has a prominent advantage in grassland resources, so it should develop animal husbandry according to local conditions and protect and rationally use grassland resources. If it one-sidedly expands the area of cultivated land and increases the output of grain and oil crops, it will deviate from the advantage of grassland resources and may damage the grassland ecology, so it does not conform to the direction of sustainable development.

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the statistics shown in the figure on population, cultivated land, and grassland resources in different systems of a certain temperate region of our country, which development practice does not conform to the direction of sustainable development in this region? <image1>
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: Expand the area of cultivated land and increase the output of grain and oil crops
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of statistics on population, cultivated land, and grassland resources in different systems of a certain temperate region of our country. The legend shows that the blank bars indicate population, the dotted bars indicate per capita cultivated land, and the diagonal-line bars indicate per capita grassland. The horizontal axis includes three systems: desert steppe, meadow steppe, and farming-pastoral combination. In the desert steppe and meadow steppe, the diagonal-line bars are clearly the highest, indicating that per capita grassland resources are abundant; the dotted bars are relatively low, indicating that per capita cultivated land resources do not have an advantage. The farming-pastoral combination system has relatively more per capita cultivated land, but less per capita grassland, and also a larger population. Then reason: The question asks about the practice that “does not conform to the direction of sustainable development in this region.” This temperate region as a whole has a prominent advantage in grassland resources, so it should develop animal husbandry according to local conditions and protect and rationally use grassland resources. If it one-sidedly expands the area of cultivated land and increases the output of grain and oil crops, it will deviate from the advantage of grassland resources and may damage the grassland ecology, so it does not conform to the direction of sustainable development.
